selected_method_cards.selection_reason: Tax valuation charge, server-life estimate and CFO addbacks require a reported-to-economic bridge.
Removable owner cash is distinct from company FCF and SBC addbacks.
Rapid AI capex requires maintenance/growth/competitively required classification.
FoA and Reality Labs require segment reconciliation; genuine RL costs retained.
Historical return claims and AI reinvestment must have defensible tangible/incremental capital denominators.
Financing outflows, leases, commitments and post-quarter bonds change cash claims.
E3 core-market dominance claim and E1 product metrics require causal moat tests.
E1 compute profitability claim must pass incremental capital return/runway test.
Any intrinsic value must be discounted complete owner cash, not an external target.
Maintenance, growth, discounting, dilution and terminal uncertainty require explicit sensitivity/blocked conclusions.
Blue Owl JV conditional guarantee requires contingent cash trigger and dependency ledger.
Each material finding needs strengthening/weakening/invalidation observations.

optional_material_handling.claim: AI recommendations raised Facebook time spent 5%.
optional_material_handling.test: Evidence of user-response mechanism, not causal moat permanence or aggregate capex ROI.
optional_material_handling.assumption_effect: Strengthens plausibility of core compute use; no numerical growth or ROI uplift.

optional_material_handling.claim: AI recommendations raised Threads time spent 10%.
optional_material_handling.test: Engagement is not incremental owner cash; experimental definitions and monetization unmeasured.
optional_material_handling.assumption_effect: Qualitative core-use corroboration only; no revenue addition.

optional_material_handling.claim: Lattice app-ad deployment raised conversions nearly 3% for that objective.
optional_material_handling.test: Scoped advertiser outcome supports ad efficiency; not universal lift or full-investment return.
optional_material_handling.assumption_effect: Supports ad performance mechanism, no extrapolation to all ads or frontier models.

optional_material_handling.claim: Automated ad tools handled a $60bn annualized revenue run rate.
optional_material_handling.test: Revenue through tools can overlap base ad revenue; distinct AI revenue bridge absent.
optional_material_handling.assumption_effect: No incremental $60bn added to revenue, cash flow or valuation.

optional_material_handling.claim: Additional or surplus compute can be used profitably in core business, external services or future demand.
optional_material_handling.test: Core experiments establish possible uses; scale, total capital, utilization, payback and incremental owner cash absent; overshoot acknowledged.
optional_material_handling.assumption_effect: Profitable core-use hypothesis retained; full-return assertion and external compute business unresolved; no ROI/payback assumption adopted.

optional_material_handling.claim: Oppenheimer reportedly downgraded Outperform to Perform.
optional_material_handling.test: Accepted only as reported historical author action; rating is not a framework output or independent owner-economics fact.

optional_material_handling.claim: Superintelligence spending may repeat metaverse economics; fast costs can offset ad growth; 2027 visibility missing.
optional_material_handling.source_type: external analyst opinion through secondary report
optional_material_handling.test: Cost absorption supported by 9M cash-capex/FCF divergence and spending guidance; project equivalence and future failure not established.
optional_material_handling.assumption_effect: Adopts cost-versus-monetization downside mechanism, not an analogy-derived loss probability or forecast; no 2027 estimates invented.

optional_material_handling.claim: Around 21x 2027 estimated earnings comparison with Alphabet.
optional_material_handling.test: Forecast series, normalized EPS, price date and model unavailable; not discounted owner cash.
optional_material_handling.assumption_effect: Excluded from numerical valuation and cutoff multiple; historical attribution retained only.

optional_material_handling.claim: Core dominance and strong growth make selloff a valuation opportunity despite AI/RL uncertainty.
optional_material_handling.test: Revenue and FoA profitability supported; dominance alone does not prove moat, and business quality cannot establish price/value gap.
optional_material_handling.assumption_effect: Core quality proposition partly supported; valuation-opportunity component unresolved; no trade instruction.

optional_material_handling.claim: $869 median target and roughly 28% upside at article-date price.
optional_material_handling.test: Survey/model/time basis unavailable; article-date upside cannot carry to cutoff price and target is not owner-cash present value.
optional_material_handling.assumption_effect: No target, upside, consensus, terminal price or valuation anchor adopted.

assumptions.description: M is assumed at 50%, 75%, or 100% of TTM total cash capex, including lease principal. These are arbitrary analytical settings, not source estimates or plausible confidence bounds.
Delta=-10000,0,+10000 is assumed aggregate normalization for working capital, cash taxes, other recurring economic cash needs and cash restrictions. No data-supported bound exists.
Deduct reported SBC as economic compensation cost. Do not also deduct settlement taxes or projected dilution. Capitalized SBC/tax/economic replacement-cost bridge is not fully established.
2572m Q3 diluted weighted-average shares held fixed as illustrative denominator, not actual December diluted shares.
Analyst required returns, not universal Buffett parameters.
Analyst growth of complete removable owner cash, not revenue forecasts.
Analyst perpetual growth after year five; unsupported terminal assumption.

Reverse equation attributes the full gross equity anchor to discounted operating owner cash. This is an algebraic convention, not a factual zero excess-cash assumption. Actual excess-cash adjustment is blocked.
Fixed Q3 diluted-share proxy; SBC expensed in owner cash, with no further dilution penalty.

method_limits: No supported owner-earnings or intrinsic-value range from unbounded maintenance/normalization inputs.
No historical return or business quality extrapolated into incremental AI return.
No buy/sell/hold, entry price, position size, trade instruction, synthetic stock score, or Buffett endorsement.
No baseline/sibling comparison, outside/current data, 2026 outcomes, private PDF or another master method.
Owner-cash algebra scenarios and reverse hurdles are conditional, not estimated fair value.

monitoring.finding: Core advertising economics supported; causal durability partly unresolved

monitoring.weaken: Higher compute and distribution expense with persistent FoA margin compression or deteriorating ad outcomes
monitoring.invalidate: Sustained weakening advertiser results and user demand defeats the scale/efficiency causal link, even if aggregate revenue remains positive
